limitations_and_boundaries: GINO is evaluated only on two CFD datasets (Ahmed-body and Shape-Net Car) and may not generalize to other PDEs or geometries.
The speed-up comparison is against a specific GPU-accelerated OpenFOAM solver; performance relative to other solvers is not assessed.
The model requires SDF and point-cloud representations, which may not be available for all geometries.
The ablation study is limited to latent space size and radius; other hyperparameters (e.g., number of Fourier modes, graph layers) are not systematically varied.
The paper does not report uncertainty estimates or confidence intervals for the error metrics.
The evaluation is limited to steady-state simulations; transient or unsteady flows are not considered.
The GINO model's performance on even larger meshes (beyond 100k surface points) is not tested.
The comparison with MeshGraphNet is only mentioned for the Ahmed-body dataset; no results are reported for Shape-Net Car.

research_questions.statement: Can a geometry-informed neural operator (GINO) efficiently learn the solution operator of large-scale 3D PDEs with varying geometries?

provenance.text_excerpt: As shown in Table 2 3 and Figure 2, GINO achieves the best error rate with a large margin compared with previous methods. On the Shape-Net Car, GINO achieves 7.12% error rate compared to 9.42% on FNO.

claims.statement: GINO achieves the best error rate on the Shape-Net Car dataset compared to previous methods.

datasets.description: Car shapes from ShapeNet Car category, manually modified to remove side mirrors, spoilers, tires. RANS equations with k-epsilon turbulence model and SUPG stabilization, finite element solver. Inlet velocity fixed at 20m/s, Reynolds number ~5e6. Each simulation ~50 minutes. Car surfaces stored with 3.7k mesh points. 611 water-tight shapes used.

methods.name: GINO
methods.protocol_description: Geometry-informed neural operator with graph-kernel blocks for encoder/decoder mapping irregular point clouds to/from a regular latent grid, and Fourier blocks on the latent grid for global interactions. Uses signed distance function (SDF) and point-cloud representations. Trained with Adam optimizer for 100 epochs, learning rate halved at 50th epoch. Channel dimensions [32,48,64,80], latent space [32,48,64,80], radius 0.025-0.055 (domain normalized to [-1,1]).

methods.name: GNO
methods.protocol_description: Graph neural operator baseline. Trained with Adam optimizer for 100 epochs, learning rate halved at 50th epoch. Starting learning rates [0.002,0.001,0.0005,0.00025,0.0001], best at 0.00025 or 0.0001.

methods.protocol_description: Geometry-aware Fourier neural operator with 2D spherical latent space due to instability with 3D deformation.
